events.content:
Migration complete. The app builds and serves correctly on App Router with both routes prerendered as static pages, identical titles, metadata, and UI verified via a production server run.

What changed:

- **`app/layout.tsx`** (new) — root layout replacing `_document.tsx` and `_app.tsx`. It carries the `<html lang="en">`/`<body>` structure from `_document.tsx`, plus shared metadata (default title/description and the favicon link that used to live in `next/head`). The viewport meta tag is no longer declared because App Router emits it automatically.
- **`app/page.tsx`** (from `pages/index.tsx`) — the `<Head>` block became a `metadata` export (`title: 'Home Page'`, description); same JSX otherwise.
- **`app/about/page.tsx`** (from `pages/about.tsx`) — same treatment with `title: 'About Us'`.
- **Routing conventions** — the plain `<a href>` navigation links were converted to `<Link>` from `next/link` for client-side navigation, per App Router conventions; rendered UI is unchanged.
- **Removed** — the entire `pages/` directory (`index.tsx`, `about.tsx`, `_app.tsx`, `_document.tsx`). `_app.tsx` was a pass-through, so nothing needed porting from it.
- `tsconfig.json` got a minor automatic update from `next build` (added `.next/dev/types/**/*.ts` to `include`).

Verification: `npm run build` compiles cleanly and outputs `/` and `/about` as static routes, and `next start` serves both pages with the correct titles, headings, and `lang="en"` attribute.
